item.text: I found one gap in the shared API: it silently discards malformed session JSON, so the caller cannot report parse failures through a `try/catch`. I’m adding an optional parse-error callback to that API; the new lookup will then log the malformed-storage error and return `null` as required, while other callers keep the existing behavior.
